statement: OpenAI's planned compute spend through 2030 has been revised upward, described as a 25% increase from earlier 2026 estimates.
why: The direction of the revision matters more than the level: budgets moving up within the same year signal demand running ahead of prior plans.

impact.mechanism: An upward in-year revision to compute budgets raises the order book that vendors and clouds plan capacity against.

confidence.basis: Secondary report; the prior-estimate baseline is attributed to a search-result summary rather than a primary source.
